== English Virtual Original comparison ==
May charges 1 Force to use any upside-down card. The 19 June revision narrows this to substitution using It Is The Future You See. Later names that same Jedi Test as #5, sets deploy 4→5 and adjusts the Dagobah discount -2→-3, retains forfeit 8, moves the training-card deployment to your deploy phase and sets attrition immunity at <4 rather than number of completed tests.
